content.title: All six cache seeds derived jointly for one full third-query history
content.text:
[2026-11-17 22:40 CET] Source f21685746f00e574ef5554a85a7c83676b11e5fc proves the exact b4b2af07 joint theorem: after ONE actual cold prefix and ONE actual middle prefix, the SAME middle snapshot preserves original source Mu inventory and satisfies all SIX initial cache laws relative to ONE fixed FULL third actual history. The six fields are C/M node, qualified edge, BodyFirst node/edge, Coherent node and TopRow edge. One derived source bodyId and one literal third entry bundle scope all four auxiliary fields. Original source, roots, operands, plans, supplied fuels and arbitrary endpoint controls remain. No caller supplies cache meaning, future Profile, body law, target inventory, model or accepted finite witness.

Node provenance splits inherited and middle-produced cells once. Each true producer supplies its own internally derived Gamma and full actual admission. Qualified producers give Profile independent of the third history. Auxiliary domains contain two distinct seen pairs and cannot equal the third entry's singleton base. Edge provenance keeps EVERY ordered input child and its SAME keyed returned cell through the producer suffix and, for cold cells, the separate literal middle query. The True Returned arguments used to extract the operational cell receipt supply no semantic meaning. Both auxiliary pairs construct uniform callbacks ONCE at the actual third entry/common reader, run the cold initializer, and then the generic family engine on the middle query using the genuine derived earlier fields. No independent query controls are concatenated.

First private29139 rejected three Node parser errors from a local variable named prefix; generated sorryAx output was rejected. A separate repair renames exactly two PRIVATE local occurrences to entryPrefix. All public/private FIRST headers and the public Node proof remain exact. Retry32348 passed three standard reports with6335verified pins. Combined54344 then failed only shadow import order; key and both auxiliary pairs passed, while Node/Edge/Joint were blocked on missing excluded objects. No proof changed. Topological retry37551 passed Key→BodyFirst→Coherent→Node→Edge→Joint: seven standard reports, zero definition checks, six private helpers transitive,6467pins verified. Both failed attempts remain preserved.

All five normal publication60614 gates passed709/7/304/709/709; all7160current pins were independently verified. Audit checked100129declarations. Source6270/import5270/Audit709/independent304. Seven fresh reports plus496inherited give503combined. All264resource-owner reports remain inherited. Seven public plus six private theorems give13source declarations; no definition was added. Three existing owners retain exact prefixes; three new modules were added. All6263other old Source files remain exact. OldAudit430643bytes stay intact after195bytes of three imports, then seven public axiom queries. Historical pins use Key/BodyFirst/Coherent/Audit BEFORE snapshots; current compiler pins use actual new Source.

This closes the concrete THIRD-history six-seed bridge. Arbitrary query sequences remain open. The next source invariant must retain H-independent closed node/edge clauses, singleton-base Profiles, all four auxiliary pairs for every numerical pid distinct from source u/bodyId, and source inventory. Two numerical callback candidates are frozen UNCOMPILED; they add zero credit. Closed Profile means closed free references and original-U boundary atoms, not language inhabitance. Actual worker attachment, native inhabitance, Type/Marker consistency, guard truth, ONE finite accepted completion of the SAME emitted root satisfying EVERY historical obligation under ONE assignment, and compiled Haskell correspondence remain open. No Haskell source changed and no reachable Haskell defect was established. Preserve older FINDINGS.

All five current compiler runs are terminal. Cleanup removed15873248owned object bytes and31494dependency links. Normal cache targets remain byte/stat preserved by the cleanup; sources, logs, unknown files and protected paths remain. Known cumulative regular cleanup is6493212045bytes. The receipt counted5826234367readable/tmp bytes with six permission errors and one concurrently vanished GHC directory. Manual continuation is authorized and the earlier usage pause remains lifted.
